Underwood No. 5 typewriter, visibly rusty/dirty as-found; rough ones go ~$50-150; not 3x at $75

Small Eastlake walnut lady's desk c.1880; ~$300-500 retail, local conservative ~$300 = only 1.5x of $200 ask, no OBO stated

Mixed lot of ~70-90 used disc golf discs (Innova, Discraft, Westside etc, many plastics); used discs resell ~$3-8 each, eBay used single ~$10-15 (estimate, ebay.com item 134494338074 lot ask $115); ask $7 looks like placeholder/per-disc price; CHECK: is $7 for whole lot, condition/wear, any rare/OOP/limited stamps (Discraft ESP/Innova star), sort and sell to local disc golf groups
$1 'Mid Era + Modern Lot' - only a Pokemon card back shown, no evidence of contents; no value basis
Small sterling scrap: turquoise ring, thin chains, earrings, singles (~20-30g); melt+ring est $60-90, short of $100
Hot Wheels Newsletter 39th Convention Lamborghini Huracan; sold comp $39.99 (ebay.de 267423163376 sold Jul 2026); $80 ask is above value
Painted yellow campaign-style desk, modern repop looking (MDF/painted); big; not worth 3x

Marvel Funko Pop lot 10+ boxed w/ protectors: Iron Man Civil War Amazon excl, Captain America GITD, Black Panther Marvel Collector Corps excl, Moon Knight Funko Shop, Dancing Groot EE excl, Mysterio Walmart GITD, blue Venom chase; excl pops ~$10-25 each so ~$130+ (estimate); CHECK: boxes mint/creased, which is the chase Venom (glow chase worth ~$25-40), counts, try to pay $30-45
Mixed stamp albums + loose, includes worn Japanese note; general world lots sell ~$20-60; no key stamps visible (estimate)

Vintage wooden post office mail sorter with state labels (about 40 slots), blue paint, wall hanging; vintage USPS sorters retail ~$150-300 (estimate, 1stdibs/estate listings); 44mi trip; CHECK: size/weight, slot count, damage, original paint, state label completeness
Antique brass fireplace fender, tarnished; sells ~$100-200 retail, ~2x at best vs $50, 42mi
Indian hand-painted dowry/marriage box; common decorative piece ~$60-100
LPS lot 80+ mostly common husky/cat pets; ~$1-3 each, priced at value
Black bakelite dial-less WE desk phone; Western Electric 302 sells median ~$35 on 79 sales (underpricedai), range $12-265
Hot Wheels RLC RWB Porsche 930 (photo looks stock); resold ~$150-200 in Sep 2025 (resellcalendar), now likely less; 1.6x of $80 ask, not 3x
Pokemon bulk with ~6 EX/full art cards + stack; modern EX cards $3-10 each, ~$50 total
$1/$2/$5 moving sale tarp of misc tools (Milwaukee flashlight/pouch, Stanley level, bits); per-item pricing, low-value small items

Pair of cast brass heron/ostrich glass-top round side tables, Hollywood Regency style; pairs list $1000+ retail on 1stdibs/Chairish, local conservative ~$360 (estimate, no solid sold comp); Southlake 6mi, car size; CHECK: glass chips, brass pitting/tarnish, wobble, both tables matching, any maker mark
Bulk Lego pile, mixed parts ~6-10 lb at ~$8-10/lb; ~$60-80, not 3x of $30
Hamm's Brewing tin sign 12x16: modern repro (flat printed, fake distress, grommet-style screws)
Hand-carved cedar drum box signed Clarence A. Wells, unknown artist, no sold comps; decorative ~$50-100 (estimate)
Stock/auction photo of Pulaski Empire-style secretary bookcase; large 2-piece cabinet, truck needed; vintage Pulaski ~$150-300 locally
